componentGroups.description: The inner components other than the logo, provided in groups based on when and where they should be shown. Valid keys are: 'menuComponent', 'alwaysShow', 'showInOverlays'

context.description: The kebab-case or BEM element chain name of the parent component or variant (if contextually relevant). Note: For components that use the BEM trait, this must be set before init_bem_classes() is called for class naming to work as expected.

logoUrl.description: The URL of the site logo image

overlayBackgroundColor.description: Background colour of the overlay when responsiveStyle is set to 'overlay'

responsiveStyle.description: The layout style of the responsive menu when below the breakpoint

shortName.description: The name of the component without any namespacing, prefixes, etc. Used for BEM block/element naming. Derived from the Blade filename if not explicitly set. If explicitly set, handling is component-specific depending on CSS requirements: some will use it in place of generic defaults, others will add a wrapper or adjust BEM classes but otherwise keep the same HTML structure.

size.description: Keyword specifying the relative width of the container for the inner content if the component is not nested inside another layout component. Ignored if the component has an isNested attribute set to true, or other logic determines that it is nested.

submenuIcon.description: Icon class name for the submenu toggle button in responsive mode
